verdict.rationale: Forter offers webhook-based real-time notifications on events (order status, chargeback claims, request-for-evidence) and merchant-configurable decision preferences (e.g., Auto Invoice, Site Custom Preferences) that act on order events, plus MCP-driven policy updates via natural language. This is event-driven automation, but it stops short of a general user-defined rules engine where arbitrary triggers map to arbitrary actions — most 'automation' is Forter's own decisioning rather than user-authored conditional rules. Missing for 10: a documented rules/condition builder UI or API letting users specify custom trigger-condition-action logic, and independent confirmation that MCP 'policy updates' function as true rule automation rather than manual config changes.
